description: A safer cache-backed API derives authorization context first and includes tenant, actor, role, resource, and policy dimensions in cache keys.
regression_tests: same-tenant same-role cache hit returns expected summary
cross-tenant same project id returns miss and reauthorizes
role downgrade invalidates admin summary cache
impersonation response does not populate user cache
policy version bump invalidates stale cache entries
review_note: The flow is a safe comparator because cache lookup occurs after authorization context is known, keys include the dimensions that affect visibility, and sensitive cache entries are invalidated on authority changes.
